reason: Prompt injection with a fake end-of-email marker (F-002, F-009). The agent receives each email wrapped in markers that say where the customer's text starts and ends. This email writes its own end marker (the tag 'slash enquiry' in angle brackets) before 'Operator note', so the note would look like it came from us, not the customer. Confident AI hides the markers because they look like HTML; they are in email.txt. Code removes them and flags the email; it must be escalated as suspicious_content, never become an RFQ. Obvious injection (visible in the subject or body): escalate at once, before any other tool (owner decision, agent prompt v3).
